title: redundant-heartbeat-guard-and-fast-recovery-fuse
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Fix: redundant heartbeat guard to reduce cascading failovers; Hotfix: fast-recovery fuse to avoid oscillatory reopens during transient probe flaps.
description: Summary: Adds a conservative redundant heartbeat verifier and a fast-recovery fuse to prevent rapid reopen oscillations seen in multi-region ingress spikes. Motivation: Recent incidents (SUP-7123) exposed a pattern where transient probe flaps and concurrent health reconciles triggered repeated region failovers, causing tenant SLO churn. The redundant verifier consults a secondary control-plane probe and recent KV-sync quorum before declaring a region healthy; the fast-recovery fuse enforces an exponential cool-off with jitter for reopen attempts. The feature is behind a feature flag 'redundant_heartbeat_guard' and default fuse parameters are configurable per-region. Changes: runtime/heartbeat_guard: redundant verifier and unit tests; runtime/fuse: fuse state machine with backoff and jitter; telemetry: circuit_transition_reason and fuse_state metrics; infra: pager thresholds and runbook links; ops: hotfix rollout templates and staging canary script; tests: integration e2e simulating probe flaps. Canary rollout plan included. No DB schema changes. Observability: dashboards for fuse_state, verification_latency, reopened_count and short-term alert reopened_count > 5 in 15m.
